name: UserExperior
description_en:
UserExperior is treated here as a legacy digital-experience/session-recording SDK product, with a documented Web SDK migration to DevRev Plug. DevRev’s official developer guide explicitly names the old SDK and shows its replacement; this is stronger lineage evidence than an inaccessible legacy homepage.

The old domain currently redirects to unrelated content, so it is not used to verify availability or price. This profile explains the documented migration boundary and does not assign every current DevRev feature to UserExperior.
description_zh:
本文把 UserExperior 作为旧数字体验及会话录制 SDK 产品研究，其 Web SDK 有迁移至 DevRev Plug 的官方文档。DevRev 开发指南明确命名旧 SDK 并给出替换方案，比无法正常使用的旧首页提供了更明确的技术沿革依据。

旧域名当前跳转至无关内容，不能核实可用性或价格。本文解释文档所示迁移边界，不把当前 DevRev 全部功能归给 UserExperior。

sections.title_en: Documented Web SDK replacement, not a guessed rename
sections.title_zh: 有文档的 Web SDK 替换，并非推测更名
sections.en: The DevRev guide identifies Plug as the replacement for legacy UserExperior Web SDK and marks NPM package support discontinued. It contrasts the old script and initialization with Plug installation, readiness events and recording settings. This establishes a specific technical migration path; it does not independently establish an acquisition date, automatic account transfer or shutdown of every native UserExperior product.
sections.zh: DevRev 指南将 Plug 明确列为旧 UserExperior Web SDK 的替代，并标注 NPM 包支持已停止，比较旧脚本初始化与 Plug 安装、就绪事件和录制设置。这可以确认具体技术迁移链路，但不能独立确认收购日期、账户自动转移或全部原生 UserExperior 产品停运。

sections.title_en: Example: inventory an existing recording integration
sections.title_zh: 示例：盘点现有录制集成
sections.en: For an existing site, list the UserExperior script, initialization, user identity calls, custom events and masking classes before planning a migration. The guide maps event tracking and session properties to Plug APIs and distinguishes DevRev user objects from older session-level properties. Use a staging account and synthetic inputs to compare behavior; changing the script URL alone is not sufficient acceptance evidence. No migration or SDK call was executed here.
sections.zh: 对于已有站点，应先盘点 UserExperior 脚本、初始化、用户身份调用、自定义事件及遮罩类，再规划迁移。指南把事件和会话属性映射到 Plug API，并区分 DevRev 用户对象和旧会话属性。应以测试环境账户及合成输入比较行为，仅更换脚本 URL 不能证明验收通过。本文未执行迁移或 SDK 调用。

sections.title_zh: 单独检查替代 SDK 的限制
sections.en: DevRev’s troubleshooting guide lists recording settings, environment IDs, CSP/network requests and identity lifecycle as diagnostic checks. It describes DOM-based capture limits for native browser controls and does not support framesets or Flutter web. These are documented Plug constraints to evaluate during migration, not newly verified capabilities or failures of the legacy UserExperior SDK.
sections.zh: DevRev 排错指南列出录制设置、环境 ID、CSP 与网络请求及身份生命周期等检查，说明原生浏览器控件的 DOM 捕捉限制，并不支持 frameset 或 Flutter web。这些是迁移时应检查的 Plug 限制，并非本文重新核实的旧 UserExperior 能力或故障。

sections.title_en: Recording and masking need observable checks
sections.title_zh: 录制及遮罩需要实际观察核对
sections.en: The migration guide preserves named masking classes and maps identity/events, while the troubleshooting guide recommends checking masks in the replay itself. A staging acceptance test should include masked text and images, login/logout identity changes and missing uploads. Successful initialization alone would not establish privacy or recording completeness. The existing data-retention, consent and access policy must be reviewed separately.
sections.zh: 迁移指南保留具名遮罩类并映射身份事件，排错指南要求在回放本身检查遮罩。测试环境验收应覆盖遮罩文字图片、登录退出身份变化和上传缺失。初始化成功本身不能证明隐私或录制完整，既有保留、同意和访问政策仍需另查。

sections.title_en: Legacy purchase and current commercial continuity are unknown
sections.title_zh: 旧产品采购及商业连续性未知
sections.en: No usable current UserExperior price, free entitlement, support contract or new-customer signup was verified. DevRev migration documentation is not a UserExperior price list, and current DevRev pricing must not be substituted. Existing customers should confirm contract, keys, historical recordings, migration assistance and recovery terms with the relevant vendor before changing production. Source licensing, native-SDK continuity and the reason for the old-domain redirect remain unknown.
sections.zh: 未核实当前 UserExperior 价格、免费权益、支持合同或新客户注册。DevRev 迁移文档不是 UserExperior 价格表，也不能套用当前 DevRev 价格。既有客户应在修改生产前，与相关厂商确认合同、key、历史录制、迁移协助及恢复条件。源码许可、原生 SDK 连续性及旧域跳转原因仍未知。
